player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika Nim.
Lengo lako ni kuchukua kitu kilichosalia.
Kila mzunguko, chagua mfuko mmoja tu na uondoe kitu kimoja au zaidi kutoka kwake.
Tumia muundo '[pile quantity]', ambapo mfuko ni nambari ya mfuko na kiasi ni idadi ya vitu kuondolewa.
Kwa mfano, '[0 3]' huondoa vitu 3 kutoka kwenye mfuko 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Onge fom mar dar ma ber. Ti kod '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pile index {pile_index} ok en e range.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Haiwezi kuondoa {quantity} kutoka kwenye mfuko {pile_index} (ni {pile_count} pekee zimesalia).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Jalo {player_id} nokawo gima ne otemo mogik!
